title: Chapter 76 Return To The Wasteland City
content:
Chapter 76 Return To The Wasteland City

The Lord of the Human Emperor Palace and the Lord of the Heavenly Court not only recovered their strength, but also became even stronger than before.

What's even more outrageous is that these two people actually joined the Huangcheng.

For a moment, Di Ming suddenly reacted.

It's the Lord of the Wilderness City!

Then Di Ming hurriedly rushed to Gu Chen and Yun Qi on the side and said excitedly: "Two brothers, can you go back and talk to your city lord, so that my Immortal Emperor Clan will join your wasteland city?"

Joining the deserted city is the general trend.

Haven't you seen the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace and the Lord of Heaven join?

If you don’t join the Immortal Clan, you will definitely be submerged in the world in the end.

When they heard Di Ming's words, the two of them were stunned.

Gu Chen glanced at Yun Qi and then said indifferently: "Captain of the Imperial Clan, I will tell you about this matter to the city lord. However, if the city lord agrees or not, that is not something we can decide."

Hearing this, Di Ming nodded repeatedly, then gave Gu Chen and Yun Qi a rhin, and said with a smile: "I would like to thank you two, a small gift, it's not worthy of respect. I hope they will be more in front of your city lord. A few good words for my immortal imperial clan.”

Looking at the ring in his hand, Gu Chen wanted to laugh a little.

They really don't like these things.

Yun Qi even threw the Na Na Ring back, "The Imperial Clan leader should not play this trick. If my city lord is willing to accept your Immortal Clan, then no one can change his opinion. If he doesn't want to ,hehe."

Yun Qi sneered and said nothing more.

On the side, Gu Chen also returned the ring in his hand to Di Ming.

"Captain of the Imperial Clan, Brother Yun's words are also mine."

Hearing this, Di Ming took two rings and was immediately embarrassed.

At the same time, I also had an ominous premonition about whether I could join the Huangcheng.

Probably not. I will not be so bad if I don’t die.

Di Ming thought this way, which was a wave of self-comfort.

Little did they know that in Lu Daosheng's eyes, the Immortal Imperial Clan was not even considered an ant nest.

At the same time, inside the ruins of the Holy Gate.

"Qin Yi! Mu Chen! I am ashamed of you and the two of you!!"

The leader of the Holy Sect, Xu Qingzhi, looked at Qin Yi and Mu Chen standing beside Lu Daosheng and roared.

......

After a while, Xu Qingzhi, who recovered from his injuries and was promoted to the divine realm, excitedly said to Lu Daosheng: "Senior, from now on, I, Xu Qingzhi, will never refuse to go through fire and water for you."

The great Mr. Lu Wuji once said that Zhenxiang may be late, but she will never be absent.

In this way, all the three major forces of the human race in the All Spirit Realm joined the Huangcheng.

And the remnants of these three major forces, under the convening of Ye Qing, had gathered together and headed towards the direction of the deserted city.

"Okay, it's time to go back."

After looking at Qin Yi and the other two, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, the three of them felt a little moved.

"Sir, where are you going?"

Qin Yi asked.

Obviously, the three of them didn't know Lu Daosheng's identity.

Looking at the doubts and curiosity in the eyes of the three of them, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Lord of the Huangcheng City, this is my identity."

A deserted city?

The three of them were puzzled, but nodded.

Although I have never heard of this force, the power of such a strong man is naturally not an ordinary force.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took the three of them to leave the relics of the Holy Gate and returned to the deserted city of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

In the palace of the Lord of Huangcheng City, Mu Chen and the other two were shocked when they looked at the surrounding environment. Is this Huangcheng?

After being surprised, the three of them were ecstatic.

It would be so satisfying to practice in such a place.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said, "Follow me, I will assign tasks to you three later."

Then Lu Daosheng walked forward.

Hearing this, the three of them reacted and hurriedly followed.

Inside the main hall.

Mu Chen and the other two stood below, and Qin Yi looked up at Lu Daosheng several times, wanting to say something, but in the end he still didn't speak.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng also said directly: "If you want to ask, just say it."

Hearing this, Qin Yi and the other two looked at each other. The next moment, Qin Yi stepped forward and said, "City Lord, the World Alliance destroyed our three forces back then. Now, the three of us have recovered and our strength has gone further. That world alliance?”

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Want to take revenge?"

The three of them nodded immediately.

The three of them hated the World Alliance to the core. When their human race in the Spirit Realm was in extremely glorious, they could even transcend the Spirit Realm and go to a broader world.

However, at that time, the Realm Alliance came, and the first sentence was to make the three forces surrender to the Realm Alliance.

How could they agree to such unreasonable requests?

The result was that the three of their forces were destroyed by the Realm Alliance.

The three forces fell directly from the peak to hell.

Perhaps in the eyes of the World Alliance, the three forces of their three are not worth mentioning at all.

Looking at the hope in the eyes of the three people below, Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Okay, I will give you a chance."

Hearing this, the three of them looked overjoyed and immediately thanked him, "We wait, thank you, the city lord!"

Lu Daosheng had already made a decision on the arrangements of the three.

"Oh, isn't this Brother Gu? Why did you come back so long?"

On the way to the city lord's mansion.

An Xing, who was about to go to the main hall to report, suddenly looked lit when he saw Gu Chen.

When Gu Chen saw An Xing, he was slightly stunned, "Brother An, long time no see."

At this time, An Xing just looked at Gu Chen with a smile.

Humph, none of you took me with you at the beginning, you regret it now, you didn't expect it, did you?

I am the real winner.

Looking at An Xing's smug look, Gu Chen simply chose to turn a blind eye and continued to head towards the City Lord's Mansion.

"Hey, hey, hey, old brother, don't go, don't you want to hear about the heroic deeds of me and the young lady in the Human Emperor Palace?"

In the hall.

Hearing the movement outside the hall, several people turned their heads and looked outside the hall.

As soon as they entered the hall, they saw Qin Yi and the other two in the center of the hall.

! ! !

Seeing Qin Yi, An Xing's pupils shrank slightly, but at this time in the hall, he didn't dare to say much.

"We are here to meet the Lord of the City."

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Did you gain anything on this trip?"

An Xing and Gu Chen nodded in succession. The gains were indeed not small, and the main gains were because of the people in front of them.

At this time, An Xing's brain was working rapidly. Isn't this the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace?

He entrusted the Human Emperor Palace to the young lady as if he was about to die, but now he appeared in the main hall of the Lord's Mansion in the Deserted City.

And he was still alive and kicking, how could he be about to die?

Could it be that this guy was saved by the Lord of the City and joined the Deserted City?

Thinking of this, An Xing nodded secretly.

This matter is indeed the style of their Lord of the City.

Suddenly, An Xing's respect for Lu Daosheng went up to a higher level.

Even such a person can be accepted under his command, he is worthy of being the Lord of the City.

On the side, Gu Chen also recognized Mu Chen among the three people. Isn't this the mysterious strong man who gave them fate in the ruins of the Heavenly Palace?

Sure enough, this mysterious strong man has also joined the Deserted City.

For a while, several people in the hall were constantly thinking.
